input: Set up a pen pal exchange with overseas friends

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Pen Pal Exchange With Overseas Friends
gold.taskDescription: Establish a structured pen pal exchange with friends living abroad, covering format, frequency, and logistics.

questions.title: Will you write physical letters or send digital messages?
questions.description: Understand whether the exchange will use traditional paper mail, email, or another digital format.

questions.title: How many overseas friends are joining this exchange?
questions.description: Determine the number of participants to plan the structure and coordination needed.

questions.title: Which countries are your pen pals located in?
questions.description: Identify the countries involved to account for postage, time zones, and language differences.

questions.title: How often do you want to exchange letters or messages?
questions.description: Establish a cadence, such as weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly, to set mutual expectations.

questions.title: Is there a theme or topic guiding your exchanges?
questions.description: Find out if there is a shared interest, language practice goal, or cultural focus shaping the content.

questions.title: Have your overseas friends already agreed to participate?
questions.description: Confirm whether participants are on board or if outreach and coordination still needs to happen.

questions.title: Do you want a shared system to track letters and replies?
questions.description: Determine if the user wants a tracking method, such as a spreadsheet or app, to manage the exchange.
